Brittany Lauda is a voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Lauda was born on February 18, 1993, and graduated from high school in 2011. As an adult, she became a voice actress and worked on English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series, as well as some video games and official apps. Lauda joined the in the middle of .
